title: Finance & Payments

debtors.title: Debtors List
debtors.info: Students with an unpaid balance on a course. Each row is one student and course. Settled counts everything applied against due charges, including discounts, not only cash.

paymentModal.title: Accept Payment
paymentModal.discountHint: Cash received. To grant a concession, record a discount separately.
paymentModal.chooseStudent: Choose a student before recording payment.
paymentModal.invalidAmount: Enter a positive decimal amount. A comma or dot may separate decimals.
paymentModal.ambiguousResult: The response was interrupted. Check whether the payment was recorded before submitting again. Your entered values are retained.
paymentModal.permissionError: Your account cannot record this payment.
paymentModal.closedPeriod: This accounting period is closed. Check the date or contact an administrator.
paymentModal.verifiedNotRecorded: I checked the payment records and confirmed this payment was not recorded.
paymentModal.discardBody: Your entered payment has not been submitted. Keep editing or discard these changes.
paymentModal.enterAmount: Enter the actual cash amount received.
paymentModal.studentSearchError: Student search could not be loaded. Retry without changing the payment.
paymentModal.noStudents: No matching students. Try another name or email.
paymentModal.courseError: Course context could not be loaded.
paymentModal.noCourses: No available enrollments were returned for this student.
paymentModal.allocationHelp: Charges on this course are settled first. Remaining credit may settle other open charges; any remainder stays unapplied according to the ledger.
paymentModal.enrollmentError: This course enrollment is unavailable. Choose another available course or refresh the originating course balance. Your payment values are retained.

paymentDetail.title: Payment #{{id}}
paymentDetail.receiptError: Receipt could not be refreshed. The payment is already recorded; retry this lookup only.

paymentCompletion.title: Recorded payment
paymentCompletion.refreshHelp: This reference stays available while balances and lists refresh.

refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the last loaded data.

overview.currentDueHelp: Charges that have come due and are still unpaid, right now.
overview.currentStudentsHelp: Students with at least one unpaid course balance, right now.
overview.collectionHelp: Cash received in this period, minus cash refunds paid out.
overview.rangeIncomplete: Choose both a start date and an end date.
overview.rangeInverted: The start date must not be after the end date.

courseBalances.title: Course balances
courseBalances.empty: There are no unpaid course balances right now. New balances appear here once charges come due.
courseBalances.error: Course balances could not be loaded.
courseBalances.info: One row per student and course, largest current balance first. Due unpaid is the part of charges already due that is still unsettled.

latestPayments.title: Latest payments
latestPayments.empty: No payments have been recorded yet. Accepted payments appear here.
latestPayments.error: Latest payments could not be loaded.
latestPayments.info: The five most recent payments, regardless of the collection period.

paymentsTab.title: Payments
paymentsTab.empty: No payments have been recorded yet.
paymentsTab.info: Original cash received for each payment. Allocations may span several courses.

debtorsTab.empty: There are no unpaid course balances for this view.
